script:
sla = frappe.get_all(
    "SLA Rule",
    filters={"priority": doc.custom_priority},
    fields=["response_time", "resolution_time"],
    limit=1
)

if sla:
    sla = sla[0]
    doc.response_by = frappe.utils.add_to_date(
        doc.creation, minutes=sla.response_time
    )
    doc.resolution_by = frappe.utils.add_to_date(
        doc.creation, minutes=sla.resolution_time
    )

# Auto map Customer from email domain

sender = doc.raised_by or doc.owner

if sender and "@" in sender:
    domain = sender.split("@")[1].lower().strip()

    customer = frappe.db.get_value(
        "HD Customer",

    )

    if customer:
        doc.customer = customer

name: Email Queue Cron
script:
email_accounts = frappe.get_all("Email Account", filters={"enable_incoming": 1}, pluck="name")
for account in email_accounts:
    job_name = f"pull_from_email_account|{account}"
    frappe.enqueue(
            "frappe.mail.doctype.email_account.email_account.pull_from_email_account",
            event="all",
            job_name=job_name,
            email_account=account,
            )

name: Cancle ticket
script:
# Lock cancelled tickets after one edit

if doc.docstatus == 2:  # Cancelled

    # If already edited once → block
    if doc.custom_cancel_edit_used:
        frappe.throw("❌ This cancelled ticket is permanently locked and cannot be edited again.")

    # First edit after cancel → mark as used
    if doc.get_db_value("docstatus") == 2:
        doc.custom_cancel_edit_used = 1

name: Resolved
Auto Close Middleware
Auto-Close on Email Alert
Manual Auto-Close on Email Alert
script:
# Check for "alert" keyword in the subject (case-insensitive)
subject_text = (doc.subject or "").lower()

if "alert" in subject_text:
    # Only auto-close if the ticket is not already Closed or Cancelled
    if doc.workflow_state not in ["Closed", "Cancelled"]:
        
        # Use db_set to update values after the document is already created
        # This avoids the "LinkValidationError" and bypasses 'Before Save' loops
        
        doc.db_set("custom_resolution_code", "Auto-Resolved")
        doc.db_set("custom_solution", "System detected 'alert' keyword. Auto-closing.")
        doc.db_set("custom_closure_code", "Closed")
        doc.db_set("custom_closure_category", "Prod Issue")
        
        # Update Workflow and Status
        doc.db_set("workflow_state", "Closed")
        doc.db_set("status", "Closed")
        
        # Update DocStatus to 1 (Submitted)
        doc.db_set("docstatus", 1)
        
        # Now that the document exists in the DB, we can safely add a comment
        doc.add_comment("Comment", text="Ticket automatically closed because 'alert' was found in the subject.")
